options.name: interval
options.description: Time in minutes between S.M.A.R.T. tests. Technically, this is how often smartd activates to check whether any tests are configured to run.

options.name: power_mode
options.description: Selects the power mode. Options are C(never), C(sleep), C(standby), and C(idle). These correspond to the C(-n POWERMODE) option to C(smartd). C(never): Check the device regardless of its power mode. C(sleep): Check the device unless it is in C(sleep) mode. C(standby): Check the device unless it is in C(sleep) or C(standby) mode. C(idle): Check the device unless it is in C(sleep), C(standby), or C(idle) mode.

options.name: temp_crit
options.description: Threshold temperature, in degrees Celsius. If a disk goes above this temperature, SMART will generate a message with log level of LOG_CRIT. Set to 0 to disable this behavior.

options.name: temp_difference
options.description: Significant temperature difference. A report will be generated if the temperature is more than C(temp_difference) degrees Celsius different from the last test. Set to 0 to disable this behavior.

options.name: temp_info
options.description: Threshold temperature, in degrees Celsius. If a disk goes above this temperature, SMART will generate a message with log level of LOG_INFO. Set to 0 to disable this behavior.
